sql: insert into "community_read_state" ("id", "user_id", "channel_id", "last_read_at", "last_read_message_id", "last_read_seq") select lower(hex(randomblob(16))) as "id", ? as "user_id", "activation_message"."channel_id", "activation_message"."created_at", "activation_message"."id", "activation_message"."seq" from "community_message" "activation_message" inner join "community_channel" "activation_channel" on "activation_channel"."id" = "activation_message"."channel_id" left join "community_channel" "activation_parent_channel" on "activation_parent_channel"."id" = "activation_channel"."parent_channel_id" left join "community_category" "activation_category" on "activation_category"."id" = COALESCE("activation_parent_channel"."category_id", "activation_channel"."category_id") where (exists (select "user"."id" from "user" inner join "community_bot_binding" on "community_bot_binding"."user_id" = "user"."id" where ("user"."id" = ? and "user"."ownerUserId" = ? and "user"."isBot" = ? and "user"."deletedAt" is null and "community_bot_binding"."is_active" = ?)) and (("activation_channel"."type" = ? and exists (select 1 from "community_channel_member" "activation_dm_self" where ("activation_dm_self"."channel_id" = "activation_channel"."id" and "activation_dm_self"."user_id" = ? and "activation_dm_self"."relation" = ?)) and not exists (select 1 from "community_channel_member" "activation_dm_peer" inner join "community_friendship" "activation_dm_block" on ("activation_dm_block"."status" = ? and (("activation_dm_block"."requester_id" = ? and "activation_dm_block"."addressee_id" = "activation_dm_peer"."user_id") or ("activation_dm_block"."requester_id" = "activation_dm_peer"."user_id" and "activation_dm_block"."addressee_id" = ?))) where ("activation_dm_peer"."channel_id" = "activation_channel"."id" and "activation_dm_peer"."relation" = ? and "activation_dm_peer"."user_id" <> ?))) or ("activation_channel"."type" <> ? and "activation_channel"."server_id" is not null and exists (select 1 from "community_server_member" "activation_server_member" where ("activation_server_member"."server_id" = "activation_channel"."server_id" and "activation_server_member"."user_id" = ?)) and (COALESCE("activation_parent_channel"."category_id", "activation_channel"."category_id") is null or "activation_category"."private" = ? or COALESCE("activation_parent_channel"."creator_id", "activation_channel"."creator_id") = ? or exists (select 1 from "community_channel_member" "activation_anchor_member" where ("activation_anchor_member"."channel_id" = COALESCE("activation_parent_channel"."id", "activation_channel"."id") and "activation_anchor_member"."user_id" = ? and "activation_anchor_member"."relation" = ?))))) and not exists (select 1 from "community_message" "activation_newer_message" where ("activation_newer_message"."channel_id" = "activation_message"."channel_id" and "activation_newer_message"."seq" > "activation_message"."seq"))) on conflict ("community_read_state"."user_id", "community_read_state"."channel_id") do update set "last_read_at" = excluded.last_read_at, "last_read_message_id" = excluded.last_read_message_id, "last_read_seq" = excluded.last_read_seq where "community_read_state"."last_read_seq" < excluded.last_read_seq

insert into "community_read_state_revision" ("user_id", "revision") select ? as "user_id", 1 as "revision" from "user" where ("user"."id" = ? and "user"."ownerUserId" = ? and "user"."isBot" = ? and "user"."deletedAt" is null and exists (select "user"."id" from "user" inner join "community_bot_binding" on "community_bot_binding"."user_id" = "user"."id" where ("user"."id" = ? and "user"."ownerUserId" = ? and "user"."isBot" = ? and "user"."deletedAt" is null and "community_bot_binding"."is_active" = ?))) limit ? on conflict ("community_read_state_revision"."user_id") do update set "revision" = "community_read_state_revision"."revision" + 1

update "community_bot_binding" set "is_active" = ? where "community_bot_binding"."user_id" in (select "user"."id" from "user" inner join "community_bot_binding" on "community_bot_binding"."user_id" = "user"."id" where ("user"."id" = ? and "user"."ownerUserId" = ? and "user"."isBot" = ? and "user"."deletedAt" is null and "community_bot_binding"."is_active" = ?)) returning "user_id"
